title: What at-home activities can support the occupational therapy my child is receiving at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: At-Home Activities Supporting Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover activities that can be done from the comfort of your home to support the occupational therapy your child is receiving at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we firmly believe the therapeutic process extends beyond our therapy centers into the child's everyday environment and activities at home. Here are some simple yet effective at-home activities you can incorporate: Play with playdough; you create shapes while giving your child's hands a good exercise, strengthening their grip. Encourage your child to thread beads into a string. It's a fun activity that enhances their fine motor skills. For social skills and understanding emotions better, engage with your child in a role-play activity. Model daily chores. Activities such as cooking, folding laundry, or garden work can be informative and present an opportunity to develop responsibility, organization, and self-help skills. And remember, you are not alone. We are always here to guide you on tackling specific challenges and making home a fun and therapeutic space.
